mapper.select: SELECT CONVERT(od.created_at , DATE) AS day, sum(od.total_price) AS revenue FROM order_detail od WHERE od.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY CONVERT(od.created_at , DATE)

SELECT r.`date` as day, r.total_revenue AS revenue FROM revenue r WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.`date` BETWEEN #{startDate} and #{endDate}
SELECT month(r.`date`) AS month, sum(r.total_revenue) AS revenue FROM revenue r WHERE CONVERT(r.`date`, YEAR) = #{year} GROUP BY year(r.`date`), month(r.`date`)
